## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `make test` passes (database tests need `make testdb`)
- [ ] No deployment-specific names, URLs or prompts in the core
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or a command changed
- [ ] No code, comments, prompts or tests copied from Open WebUI releases after v0.6.5
